description: Defines the class 'ran_slice_instance' which manages internal state and scheduling information for a RAN slice, including grants, slots, and associated UEs.

classes.name: ran_slice_instance
classes.description: Manages RAN slice instantiation details, including grants, UEs, and slot scheduling.

methods.name: store_pdsch_grant
methods.description: Stores a PDSCH grant, updating RB count and last allocated slot.

methods.name: store_pusch_grant
methods.description: Stores a PUSCH grant, updating RB count for a specific slot.

methods.name: get_ues
methods.description: Returns the repository of UEs associated with this slice.

methods.name: nof_pusch_rbs_allocated
methods.description: Returns the number of RBs allocated for PUSCH in a given slot.

methods.name: nof_slots_since_last_pdsch
methods.description: Calculates slots elapsed since last PDSCH allocation.

methods.name: nof_slots_since_last_pusch
methods.description: Calculates slots elapsed since last PUSCH allocation.

methods.name: average_pdsch_rbs_per_slot
methods.description: Returns the average RBs scheduled for PDSCH per slot.

methods.name: average_pusch_rbs_per_slot
methods.description: Returns the average RBs scheduled for PUSCH per slot.
